pieverse.upside: Its agent-payments tooling (x402 invoices, pieUSD) sits in a theme traders are chasing, and a Binance listing or new Binance Alpha campaign could extend the run, but nothing is dated.
pieverse.cheap: It is not cheap: it hit a new high yesterday, is up about 150% this month and only about 27% of tokens are out, so most of the dilution is still ahead.
pieverse.wrongIf: It gives back this week's gain, or an unlock or exchange inflow shows up before any new product or listing news.
pieverse.vsScanner: The scanner likes the volume and ranking jump, but a coin at its all-time high with 73% of supply still locked is late, not early.

readyai.upside: A real data-labelling subnet with an x402 revenue-to-buyback loop and enterprise data deals; buybacks funded by revenue would be a genuine driver if they start.
readyai.cheap: Bittensor subnet tokens as a group are out of favour and this one is down about 95% from its July 2025 peak, so nobody is paying for the product story.
readyai.wrongIf: No buyback or named enterprise customer is announced by the end of December 2026, or daily trading falls back under $50K.
readyai.vsScanner: Today's 21x trading jump came with no news I could find, so the spike itself is not a reason; the product is the only reason to keep watching.

nakamoto-games.upside: The studio keeps shipping (a Roblox title, Bigger Bite, a promised tournament), so a working tournament season could bring players back.

nakamoto-games.wrongIf: The teased tournament has no date by the end of December 2026, or daily trading drops under $200K.
nakamoto-games.vsScanner: Agree it is alive, but the scanner has no dated reason either; this is a watch, not a buy.

dimo.upside: A real connected-car data network with actual users; a new automaker or insurer partnership would matter.
dimo.cheap: DePIN tokens are out of favour and nothing new has been announced.
dimo.wrongIf: Trading falls back to normal and the price breaks below its October low.
